notes: Every page on the site, the sitemap and the linked YouTube channel answered normally; no captcha, 403 or bot check. Nothing was downloaded, so photo content was judged from file names, the pages they sit on and the pixel sizes the site publishes, not by eye. Logo is the desktop header logo (nocircle_logo-01.png), original file without the size suffix; the footer logo is a smaller 428 by 228 copy. No heroImage given: the facts file uses the site's own header photo (YongalaDive_AlvaBeach.jpg, 1500 by 1000, the poster image behind the home page video loop). Photos on the site are often uploaded more than once under different folders; one copy of each is listed. Left out: yongalabackground-01.png (a background graphic), yongala_postcard.gif (a small graphic), two Screen Shot png files on the Divemaster and Contact pages (screenshots), the home page 'Untitled.png' (1830 by 1168 png of unknown content, not a clear photo), the Museum of Underwater Art photo on the Divemaster and Who Can Dive pages (a different attraction from the one they dive), five marine life photos with generic names (GiantTrevally, Bullshark_yongala, Loggerheadturtle_yongalawreck, Marbleray-SS-Yongala, School-of-Bullrays-SS-Yongala; no credit on the site but they look carried over from an older site, so ownership is not clear), and the favicon. Four photos with Facebook-style file names (on the history and marine life pages) were also left out because they may have been supplied by guests; one more with that style of name, the Yongala Express boat photo on the About page, is kept as the only photo of the vessel, so a person should confirm it. The Divemaster trip has one photo (image-asset.jpeg, 2500 by 1667, content unchecked). The private charters photos come from that page; two of them are portrait shots. Videos: the five YouTube videos are the operator's own uploads on the channel the site links to (the channel shows them as 13 to 17 years old, so the picture quality is dated). The Vimeo link is the silent background loop on the home page, recorded from the page code and not played, so its content and title are not verified; two more Vimeo loops (private charters, 463300012, and Divemaster, 462882696) were not added because of the six video limit. Left out of the YouTube list: 'S.S.YONGALA WRECK by TOURISM QLD' (made by a tourism body), 'TNQ Yongala Channel 10 news Jan 11' (a TV news item), 'Yongala Bathymetric scan - Pre Cyclone Yasi' (a survey scan, maker not stated) and an untitled clip named MVI_2925.MOV.
